tiny.label: Tiny
tiny.description: Fastest and smallest option. Best for quick local testing, with lower accuracy on mixed-domain speech.

base.label: Base
base.description: Balanced default. Good starting point for daily local dictation and mixed Chinese / English speech.

small.label: Small
small.description: Higher accuracy with moderate local resource usage. Suitable for longer notes and meetings.

medium.label: Medium
medium.description: High-accuracy local model for heavier terminology and multi-speaker scenarios, but it needs much more disk and compute.

large-v3-turbo.label: Large v3 Turbo
large-v3-turbo.description: Highest local accuracy in this preset list. Best for demanding recognition quality if your device can handle it.

commands.title: Commands
commands.description: Commands are scoped to each workspace. Manage project commands from the workspace automation panel instead of a global settings library.
commands.usageHint: Open a conversation that is bound to a workspace, then edit Commands there to save them into .contextgo/commands.json for that project.
commands.emptyState: No global command library is used anymore.
commands.customDescription: Add your own reusable workflow prompts for any assistant.
commands.namePlaceholder: Use letters, numbers, hyphen, or underscore
commands.descriptionPlaceholder: Explain when this command should be used
commands.templatePlaceholder: Enter the prompt template that should be inserted into the chat input
commands.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this command?

validation.invalidName: Command name must use letters, numbers, hyphen, or underscore

plan.description: Restate the task, identify risks, and produce a step-by-step plan before coding.
plan.template: Restate the task, identify the main constraints and risks, then propose a clear step-by-step implementation plan. Do not modify files yet. Wait for confirmation before executing.

tdd.description: Drive the task with failing tests first, then make the minimum code changes to pass.
tdd.template: Implement this task with test-driven development. Start by listing the risky behaviors, write or update failing tests first, then make the minimum code changes to pass. Finish by summarizing coverage and remaining risks.

codeReview.description: Review the current changes for bugs, regressions, risky assumptions, and missing tests.
codeReview.template: Review the current changes like a strict code reviewer. Prioritize bugs, regressions, missing tests, and risky assumptions. Cite concrete files and line-level evidence when possible.

security.description: Audit auth, permissions, secrets, injection risks, and unsafe data or shell handling.
security.template: Perform a security review for this task or patch. Look for auth, permission, secret handling, injection, data exposure, and unsafe shell or file operations. Report concrete risks and mitigations first.

verify.description: Verify behavior, edge cases, typing, linting, tests, and release readiness end to end.
verify.template: Verify the current implementation end to end. Check behavior, edge cases, typing, linting, tests, and release risks. Summarize what passed, what failed, and what remains unverified.

orchestrate.description: Break the task into coordinated workstreams, roles, dependencies, and checkpoints.
orchestrate.template: Break this task into coordinated workstreams. Propose the best roles or agents for each stream, dependencies between them, and the integration order. Then execute in a controlled sequence with checkpoints.
